name: geoprims
description: Exact, cited geospatial, aviation, drone, survey, and unit calculations. Offline, with no network access at all.
long_description:
geoprims answers the calculations practitioners actually do — geodesics and datums, airspeed and density altitude, ground sampling distance and mission plans, traverses and curves, grid references and cell indexes — from one local server that never reaches the network. Every answer carries its units, its method, its accuracy, and the source it comes from, and every tool is checked against golden vectors and, where a reference implementation exists, against that implementation on tens of thousands of cases.

The six meta-tools let an agent find a tool, read its contract, run it, chain several, convert units, and report a problem. Optional direct toolsets expose the stable tools of a domain as their own tools when an agent works in one area.

tools.name: geoprims_search
tools.description: Find the tool for a question, ranked, with the values the question fills in

tools.name: geoprims_describe
tools.description: A tool's inputs, outputs, units, method, accuracy, sources, and worked example

tools.name: geoprims_run
tools.description: Run a tool, with units, warnings, and the steps behind the answer

tools.name: geoprims_pipeline
tools.description: Run several tools in order, passing each answer to the next

tools.name: geoprims_convert_units
tools.description: Convert a quantity between units, exactly

tools.name: geoprims_report_problem
tools.description: Report a wrong or unclear answer, with the inputs that produced it

toolsets.title: Direct toolsets
toolsets.description: Expose the stable tools of these domains as their own tools, beside the six meta-tools. Comma-separated, from: geodesy-core, navigation, e6b, atmosphere, drone-mapping, survey-cogo, indexing. Leave empty for the meta-tools alone.
